title: Antidote
description: A better performance alternative for Optifine. Fabric-based.
body:
## 🌿 Overview
Antidote is a modpack designed as a better performing alternative to Optifine. It includes the vast majority of OptiFine's features such as built-in shader support, improvements in rendering performance, custom texture features, zoom and capes support.
## 🌟 Features
- 🚀 Improved Performance
- 🧑‍🎨 Shader Support
- 🌐 Instant Language Switching
- 🫗 Reduced RAM usage
- 👻 Enhanced Block and Entity Rendering
- 🛡️Automatically reduces resource usage when minimized
- 🪟 Doesn’t render blocks/entities outside your view
### 🖼️ Optifine Features
- 🔍 Zoom
- 🦸‍♂️ Capes
- 🌅 Shaders
- 🍃 Cull Leaves
- 💡 Dynamic Lighting
- 🖼️ Animated Textures
- 🔗 Connected Textures
- 🔳 Custom GUI
- 🪙 Custom Items
- ☁️ Custom Sky
- 🎲 Random Entity Textures
- 📐 Custom Entity Models
- 🌈 Custom Colors
